query: Which maternal inputs (schooling years, continuous labor force participation, childcare hours, maternal mental health) most consistently mediate intergenerational earnings in Latin America across cohort and administrative data?

response.query: Which maternal inputs (schooling years, continuous labor force participation, childcare hours, maternal mental health) most consistently mediate intergenerational earnings in Latin America across cohort and administrative data?
response.answer: Maternal schooling years and mental health most consistently mediate intergenerational earnings in Latin America. Continuous labor force participation and childcare hours have less consistent effects.
